about_the_game:
Unleash your inner ass-kicking menace in this unique “First-Person Booter”. Step into the boot of Glum, the crude, short-tempered goblin, and kick, cuss and fight your way through a vibrant and physics-based world that - unlike your average Sunday morning cartoon - is not suited for sticky children.

GLUM is a game where one man’s tragedy is another man’s comedy.

What's in this demo?

The demo lets you experience what delivering bone-snapping and physics-defying kicks feels like whilst exploring the action comedy world of GLUM. You get to experience everything the magical boot currently has to offer, and toy around with both the wacky environment as well as unsuspecting low IQ enemies.

In the demo you can expect:

  • Kick-ass Physics Combat - Our physics-based combat system ensures that every enemy you take down reacts dynamically, meaning glorious, over-the-top ragdoll chaos. Smash, launch, and obliterate foes in ways that are as satisfying as they are hilarious.

  • Brand New Menace System - Earn style points for creative kills! Whether you’re flinging explosive barrels and magical potions at your enemies, or getting up close and personal, the game now rewards your flair for destruction!

  • Wacky Exploration & Collectables - GLUM’s crude humor is scattered around the environments of the game, making those hidden spots and cheeky collectables worth every moment of exploring. 

This demo gives a glimpse of what's to come, and allows us to gather your thoughts of what we're working on. Help us shape GLUM with your invaluable feedback.

content_descriptors.notes: GLUM features bloody violence, gore in a cartoony setting and strong language.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: In this unique “First-Person Booter” you take on the role as Glum, the crude ass-kicking goblin with his magical ass-kicking boot. Indulge in wacky physics-based combat, over-the-top violence and dark humour with a dash of platforming and points for being extra stylish and sadistic.
